exams_to_schedule_desc: These mandatory exams of the test must be scheduled before opening enrollments.
optional_exams_desc: You can offer these optional exams to the candidates of this session.
available_days_hint: Days in green are within the session interval.
exam_delete_conflict: This exam cannot be deleted: candidates are enrolled in it.
cancel_preview_summary: {{enrollments}} enrolled, {{payments}} payment(s) will be refunded via Stripe (total {{total}}), {{invoices}} invoice(s) cancelled.
cancel_preview_unavailable: Unable to compute the cancellation impact. Refunds will still be attempted.
refund_errors_warning: Session cancelled, but {{count}} Stripe refund(s) failed. Please check the related payments.
status_help_locked: Locked: enrollments closed, session preparation (convocations, subjects).
status_help_validated: Validated: session confirmed and held, final documents (convocation available to candidates, attendance certificates after the last exam).
comment_placeholder: Internal notes about this candidate (special needs, situation, etc.)
delete_enrollment_desc: The enrollment of {{name}} will be removed from the session. This action cannot be undone.
delete_enrollment_paid: This candidate paid {{amount}}: a Stripe refund will be issued and a credit note generated.
delete_enrollment_unpaid: No payment recorded for this enrollment.
delete_enrollment_preview_unavailable: Unable to check payments. Please verify the refund manually.
transfer_desc: Only open sessions of the same test are listed. The target session must have scheduled the same exams.
transfer_no_target: No other open session for this test.
transfer_no_exams: No exam linked to this enrollment.
sms_template_reminder: Reminder: your exam {{exam}} takes place on {{date}}. Please bring an ID document.
sms_template_payment: Your payment is pending for the session {{assessment}} on {{date}}. Please complete your enrollment.
doc_rules: The registration confirmation and certificate are always available. The convocation is available once the session is validated. The attendance certificate is available after the last exam.
reason_SESSION_NOT_VALIDATED: the session is not validated yet
reason_BEFORE_LAST_EXAM: the last exam has not taken place yet
batch_print_desc: Select a document type and the enrolled candidates, then start printing.
no_enrollment: No candidate enrolled in this session.
batch_no_document: No document available for the selection.
batch_no_template: No document template is configured for this type.
transition_open_desc: The session becomes visible in public search and candidates can enroll and pay.
transition_lock_desc: No more enrollments will be possible. The session currently has {{count}} enrolled candidate(s). You can reopen enrollments by setting a new deadline.
transition_validate_desc: Final step: the session is confirmed as held and invitations and certificates become available to candidates.
transition_validate_missing_scores: {{count}} exam(s) have no result entered yet.
transition_reopen_locked_desc: Set a new enrollment deadline: the session will be open again until that date.
transition_new_limit_date_hint: Must be in the future and before the session starts ({{date}}).
transition_reopen_title: Move the session back to draft?
transition_reopen_desc: The cancelled session becomes an editable draft again, hidden from the public.
delete_draft_desc: The draft session will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete_enrollment_disabled: Only possible during the enrollment period (open session, before the deadline).
form_limit_date_hint: Enrollments close automatically at this date.
form_create_success: Session created: now schedule its exams.
form_limit_before_start: The enrollment deadline must be before the session starts
form_places_only_increase: Open session: seats can only increase (minimum {{count}})
form_open_restrictions: Session open for enrollment: start and end dates are locked and seats can only increase.
